subject: A quick question
text: I wanted to mention a small issue before sending the next draft. I noticed the image folder you shared does not include two of the screenshots referenced in the notes, so I have temporarily used clear placeholders in the layout. If you could resend just those two files, even by a quick reply to this message, I can finish the review without delay. I would also appreciate a short note on whether you prefer the captions to stay above or below the images. Thank you for understanding, and I look forward to your reply. Best,
